Gemini

OverviewFeaturesUse casesPricingTradeoffsCompatibilityFAQ

What is Gemini?

Google's multimodal assistant, sold through the Google AI consumer subscription ladder (formerly 'Gemini Advanced') and bundled into Google Workspace. Combines chat, search grounding, image and video generation, and deep Workspace integration.

Best for

Anyone already inside Google Workspace/Drive who wants AI where their files already live.

Main features

  • Gemini 3.x model family with 1M-token context
  • Deep Research
  • Veo video generation and Flow editor
  • Deep Think reasoning on top tiers
  • Gemini Spark background agent
  • Antigravity agentic dev platform
  • Jules coding agent
  • NotebookLM
  • Canvas
  • Google Workspace side panels.

Practical use cases

  • Drafting in Docs and Gmail
  • analysing Sheets
  • summarising Drive files
  • research with live search grounding
  • video and image generation for marketing
  • Android on-device assistance.

Who is it for?

  • Google Workspace and Android users, students, creators, developers and enterprises already on Google Cloud.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium consumer subscription bundled with Google One storage; Workspace seat licensing; token-metered API

Plans described in the source

Free $0. Google AI Plus $4.99/mo (cut from $7.99 on 8 June 2026; 400 GB storage, 2x free limits). Google AI Pro $19.99/mo (4x limits, 5 TB storage, YouTube Premium Lite, Google Home Premium, 1,000 Flow credits). Google AI Ultra in two tiers since I/O 2026: $99.99/mo (5x Pro, 20 TB) and $199.99/mo (20x Pro, reduced from $249.99; adds Project Genie). Annual billing now available on every paid plan. Gemini is bundled into Workspace Business Standard/Plus/Enterprise - the standalone Workspace add-on was dropped in 2025.

Free plan

Yes - free Gemini app access with capped limits and older model routing.

Free trial

No continuously available trial; promotional trials appear periodically (e.g. device and carrier bundles). Google AI Studio is free with daily request limits and no card.

Usage limits to consider

Compute-based rather than message-count limits: a heavy Deep Research session burns quota far faster than plain chat, so identical plans can hit walls at different times. Extra AI credits are sold when quota runs out. Newest Flash models are restricted to Pro/Ultra in the app; free tier stays on an older Flash.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Unmatched bundle value - 5 TB storage plus YouTube Premium Lite at the $19.99 tier
  • native Workspace integration
  • 1M-token context standard
  • strongest consumer video generation via Veo.

Limitations to consider

  • Plan names 'AI Plus' vs 'AI Pro' are easy to confuse
  • compute-based quotas are opaque
  • some Ultra features are US-only (Gemini Spark) or locked to the $199.99 tier (Project Genie)
  • pricing restructured twice in 2026.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Android (deep OS integration), iOS, Chrome, Workspace apps (Docs, Sheets, Gmail, Slides, Meet)

Languages

  • 40+ languages including Arabic, French and English

API access

Yes - Gemini API via Google AI Studio and Vertex AI. Gemini 3.1 Pro ~$2/$12 per 1M tokens (200K context), $4/$18 above; Flash tiers around $0.75/$3.75 on introductory pricing to 31 Dec 2026.

Integrations and exports

  • Google Workspace end-to-end, Google Cloud/Vertex, Android, Chrome, YouTube, Google Home
  • third-party via API

Evaluation notes

Anyone already paying for Google One storage should net that saving off the $19.99 before comparing to ChatGPT or Claude. Ultra's 'starting at $99.99' hides a real feature split between the two Ultra tiers.
